f_01KXACCVEAZE5T2YNQGVPS29TD.subject: job_scope_type
f_01KXACCVEAZE5T2YNQGVPS29TD.content: This is a two-story addition (~30' x 10') adding basement-level storage and a second-floor expansion containing a primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet at 308 Evergreen Street.

f_01KXACCVEBP70WN5MAN8XX88PD.subject: addition_footprint
f_01KXACCVEBP70WN5MAN8XX88PD.content: The addition footprint is approximately 30 feet by 10 feet (300 sq ft).

f_01KXACCVEBSVY12K8VEWHZA6AM.subject: foundation_spec
f_01KXACCVEBSVY12K8VEWHZA6AM.content: Foundation is continuous 12"x12" perimeter concrete footings with 4" gravel base, vapor barrier, and 4" smooth concrete slab; no CMU or full-height foundation walls.

f_01KXACCVEBQZQCERD39Q07Y8TT.subject: lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXACCVEBQZQCERD39Q07Y8TT.content: Structural scope includes one engineered 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" to open a load-bearing wall, with temporary shoring included.

f_01KXACCVEBB08AEEPH681WA4MY.subject: roof_pitch_detail
f_01KXACCVEBB08AEEPH681WA4MY.content: New addition roof is 3/12 pitch tying into the existing 6/12 roof pitch; architectural asphalt shingles to match existing.

f_01KXACCVEB0MPE2YYWZT6S5G7Z.subject: electrical_subpanel_spec
f_01KXACCVEB0MPE2YYWZT6S5G7Z.content: Electrical scope includes one new 100-amp subpanel with full rough-in and trim-out; scope explicitly states only an assumption that existing service can support the new subpanel.

f_01KXACCVEBX5MZW5EJQ8S83EG3.subject: window_spec
f_01KXACCVEBX5MZW5EJQ8S83EG3.content: Scope includes four windows: three 36"x60" and one transom window.

f_01KXACCVEBWKZE39NJWG1MCZK8.subject: septic_scope_callout
f_01KXACCVEBWKZE39NJWG1MCZK8.content: Scope requires a TDEC septic inspection and evaluation of septic relocation or grinder pump connection to sewer; those remediation costs are explicitly excluded as change-order items.

f_01KXACCVEBNV0E6AA7WY5675G4.subject: elevator_shaft_framing
f_01KXACCVEBNV0E6AA7WY5675G4.content: A 4'x4' future elevator shaft is to be framed and a dedicated 120V, 30A circuit installed; the elevator itself is excluded from scope.

f_01KXACCVEC02WWRE2SZGF4V5HW.subject: job_status_current
f_01KXACCVEC02WWRE2SZGF4V5HW.content: Job status is 'waiting_work' with medium priority; no completion date is set.

f_01KXACCVECV7W1VAXJ6HEFBGJS.subject: exterior_demo_items
f_01KXACCVECV7W1VAXJ6HEFBGJS.content: Site work includes saw-cutting/removing existing concrete walkway sections, removing railroad ties, relocating the existing heat pump and electrical disconnect, and extending the gas water heater vent through the new roof.
